item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a concave mirror used in two ways: held close to a small object for enlarged viewing, and facing parallel light rays that meet at a point for light concentration.

Which claim correctly matches concave tools to those needs?

options.A: A concave mirror can give an enlarged image of a nearby object and can also concentrate parallel light rays toward a focus.
options.B: Only a plane mirror can enlarge a nearby object; a concave mirror never enlarges.
options.C: A convex mirror concentrates parallel rays to a focus and enlarges nearby objects.
options.D: A concave mirror enlarges only when the object is far from the mirror, never when it is close.
